observation.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
R="--resolve app.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP --resolve admin.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP --resolve qgis.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP"
echo "=== app root ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" $R https://app.localhost/
echo "=== api root ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk $R https://api.localhost/api/v1/ | head -c 300; echo
echo "=== api schema ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" $R https://api.localhost/api/v1/schema/
echo "=== admin ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" $R https://admin.localhost/admin/login/
echo "=== qgis ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "$R https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities"
